row.title: Tenant posts with a figure need a source
row.body: NO-MADE-UP-NUMBERS-1 extended to tenant social queues: the core publisher holds back any tenant post that states a figure without an https source and logs it as unsourced-held. Syndication sites that need a person's sign-up are recorded as gate syndication-accounts with the feed, WebSub, IndexNow and five live channels as the default in effect.
